10-28.harrisEnglish: in the fourth quarter when time was pressing, the tasks were heavy and pressure was great, some people forgot the previous lesson and decided to pay the workers overtime.
10-28.backTranslation: 在第四季度，时间紧、任务重、压力大，有些人忘记了过去的教训，决定给工人发加班费。
10-28.bbcVisibleCorrespondence: 第四季度、time was pressing、tasks were heavy、pressure was great、forgot the previous lesson、pay the workers及加班字样；重影存在，不提供BBC无疑义逐字转录。

10-29.harrisEnglish: After comrades of Number 14 work group of Number 5 workshop wrote an article, Do we work hard to make greater contributions or to earn more money?, they were greatly educated and enlightened ideologically.
10-29.backTranslation: 五号车间十四工作组的同志发表《我们苦干是为了作出更大贡献，还是为了多拿钱？》之后，在思想上受到很大教育和启发。
10-29.bbcVisibleCorrespondence: No 14 work group of No 5 workshop；Do we work hard to make greater contributions, or to earn more money?；were greatly educated and enlightened ideologically。字形粘连，但编号、题名及尾句足以交叉定位。
